default_exit._why: one exit for every family so rules compete on the same footing; the owner will decide the demo stop/take-profit later and this block changes then (a change = a new screen run, its variants counted again)
default_exit._fills: signal at the close of bar t; market order at the open of the 1-minute bar that starts at t's close (+ slippage); every 1-minute bar from the entry minute on: stop first (fills at the stop or the gap open, - slippage), then the target (a limit: needs a trade 1 tick through, fills at the target); time exit at the open of the first minute at or after entry + max_hold_min; flat at the session's flatten time; one position at a time; at most max_entries_per_session entries per session

E-069.title: Bar-open gap fill fade
E-069.hypothesis: A bar that opens well away from the previous bar's last trade and keeps the gap at its close was printed through an empty book (liquidity providers pulled quotes for a moment), not by new information; once quotes refill, the vacuum is closed by passive traders leaning back toward the last trade, so fade the gap.

E-070.title: Aroon crossover follow
E-070.hypothesis: Chande's Aroon measures how recently the window's high and low were made and is a stock trend trigger on retail platforms; when the oscillator swings to a strong positive (negative) value, the latest extreme is fresh while the opposite one is stale, and the timing-based trend followers who use it enter together, extending the move; follow the cross.

E-071.title: Volume-clock bucket move follow
E-071.hypothesis: In volume time (buckets of a fixed number of contracts, Easley/Lopez de Prado), a bucket whose price change is large means the contracts in it were traded mostly by one side; informed parents are split across buckets, so the next bucket keeps the sign; follow a large completed bucket.

E-072.title: PFR reversal-close bar (Stormer)
E-072.hypothesis: The PFR (preco de fechamento de reversao) is one of the most traded Brazilian retail setups: a bar that makes a low below the two previous lows (and the recent low) but closes above the previous close shows the sellers' push failing inside one bar; the sellers who sold the new low are trapped and the many setup users buy right after it, so follow the reversal (mirror for highs).

E-073.title: Hidden RSI divergence continuation
E-073.hypothesis: On the buying side of the VWAP, a higher price low made while the RSI makes a lower low means the pullback was sharp but did not cost the trend any ground: momentum-based sellers were absorbed by trend holders; the first close above the prior bar's high resumes the trend (mirror below the VWAP).

E-074.title: VWAP skew in the day's range
E-074.hypothesis: When the session VWAP sits well above the midpoint of the day's range, most of today's contracts traded in the upper part: buyers own the day's inventory and lower prices were rejected quickly; short-term breaks up in such a session are carried by that inventory owner, so follow a short-term high break only when the volume skew agrees (mirror).

E-075.title: Unfilled opening-gap direction break
E-075.hypothesis: An overnight gap that has not been filled at all during the session is overnight information that local traders failed to reverse; the gap side holds the inventory, so intraday breaks in the gap direction are followed while breaks against it are not traded; follow N-minute highs (lows) on unfilled gap-up (down) days.

E-076.title: Session-VWAP slope turn
E-076.hypothesis: The session VWAP is the average cost of everyone who traded today; when its slope turns clearly positive with price above it, the average participant is being forced to pay up and late shorts are losing on the day's average, so VWAP-benchmarked execution and covering keep lifting price; follow the slope turn (mirror).

E-077.title: Daily-candle colour flip follow
E-077.hypothesis: The session open is the zero line of every day trader's daily candle and of intraday P&L for the day; after price has stayed on one side of it for a while, a close back across flips the daily candle's colour on every chart, triggering day traders' bias changes and the stops of those positioned for the old colour; follow the flip.

E-078.title: Prior-session close-location carry break
E-078.hypothesis: A session that closed near its high means buyers were still adding into the close (late informed or rebalancing flow not yet finished); that flow carries into the next session, so today's short-term high breaks are followed after a strong close and low breaks after a weak close (mirror).
